expr: (() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row]')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('T4 portal-approve')); if (!row) return 'NO-ROW'; const btns = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b => b.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean); return 'ROW: ' + row.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,80) + ' | BTNS: ' + btns.join(','); })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row]')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('T4 portal-approve')); const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Approve'); if (!btn) return 'NO-APPROVE-BTN'; btn.click(); return 'clicked Approve'; })()

(() => { const row = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr, [role=row]')).find(r => r.textContent.includes('T4 portal-approve')); return row ? 'AFTER-APPROVE: ' + row.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0, 100) : 'row gone'; })()
